notes.title: Playtest now live! 🥏
notes.notes:
The public playtest is now live for everyone to join, hit the request access button on the Steam page and get instant access to the game.

The playtest will feature a singleplayer, 9-holes experience that we need your feedback on!
There is a leaderboard to see who will emerge with the best score of this playtest!

For feedback, please fill in this form: https://forms.gle/9RmHKq7kSu5fBJcH6


Get access here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2819400/Disc_Golf_Masters/

notes.title: First Playtest Starts May 6 🥏
notes.notes:
The first public playtest for Disc Golf Masters kicks off on May 6 — and you can sign up right now.

Head to this Steam page's top and click “Request Access” to join.
Once the playtest goes live, you’ll get an invite automatically.

This is your chance to test the game early, give feedback, and help us shape Disc Golf Masters before launch.

Multiplayer, career mode, real courses, licensed discs — and more to come.

✅ Don’t forget to wishlist the game while you’re here — it helps a ton.

See you on the course,
– Spin-Off Games & Bonus Stage

https://steamcommunity.com/app/2819400

notes.title: Disc Golf Masters – From the Creators of Disc Golf Valley
notes.notes:
If you’ve played Disc Golf Valley, you know what’s coming next.

We’re proud to finally announce Disc Golf Masters – a brand new disc golf game for PC and consoles, developed by Spin-Off Games and published by Bonus Stage.

[b]This is a full-featured disc golf sim with:

[/b]• Real-world-inspired courses
• Licensed discs from Latitude 64°, Discmania, Westside Discs, and Kastaplast
• Pro athletes
• Career mode
• Online and local multiplayer
• Leagues, progression, and deep customization

It’s everything we’ve wanted to build — and it’s coming first to Early Access on Steam.

💬 Join the official Discord for updates, playtest info, and to talk with the devs:
[url= https://discord.gg/VYDHVrs3S8]Disc Golf Masters Discord[/url]
